name: DCA Flo's V8 Cafe Famous Fried Chicken (Peel Crispy Skin Mod) & Roasted Garlic Mashed Potatoes
brandOrRestaurant: Flo's V8 Cafe (Cars Land · Disney California Adventure)
searchKeywords: cars land fried chicken mashed potatoes
whyItWorks: Like Plaza Inn across the esplanade, Flo's serves tender bone-in chicken with creamy mashed potatoes; peeling away the seasoned fried skin gives you juicy white-meat chicken.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Peel off the crispy fried breading, ask for gravy on the side, and take a lactase tablet for the mashed potatoes.
watchOuts: Mashed potatoes at Flo's contain roasted garlic and dairy—take lactase and avoid if sensitive to garlic
